scope: Source application acceptance for literal standard GF180 C/D 3.3 V and IHP LV/HV MOS physical grouping. Twenty-two finite native cases in two separately retained producers; no full operating-envelope or electrical-accuracy qualification.
problem: The public native comparator can pass wrong nf/ng and equivalent wrong physical-copy grouping. The current application now checks terminal-associated physical groups separately and preserves the actual native LVS result.
source_identity: Exact combined native v2 snapshot: baseline plus retained overlay. Every manifest file was checked before and after execution and again during primary evidence retention.

coverage: connected internal node renamed by extraction
primary_native.saved_bench: Matching GF180 C bench completes schematic simulation, native checks, capacitance extraction and post-layout simulation. Wrong nf retains native LVS passed, verifies failure evidence, and stops before PEX and post-layout simulation.
primary_native.internal_mapping: Actual source node N maps to native a_0_n200# through a retained native legal-node partition; no forced equivalence.
primary_native.closure: work/grouping-shared-integration-v2/mos-native-closure; complete baseline source and combined overlay are retained by the integration bundle.

separate_pmos_supplement.scope: Independent ordinary Magic/Netgen PMOS checks for GF180 C/D and IHP LV/HV at the same W/L/finger/copy settings and 90 degrees. No additional saved-bench or public-checker sweep.
separate_pmos_supplement.raw_audit: Each actual native netlist and written mask has six channels in two groups of three; matching and wrong-reference runs preserve their independent native LVS/integrity outcomes.

independent_synthetic_controls.scope: Five synthetic geometry/terminal controls plus eight synthetic native-correspondence parser controls. These are not native-engine acceptance.
independent_synthetic_controls.key_negative: Swapped per-net groups are rejected despite identical global group totals and identical channel counts/dimensions on each net; partial native-site overlap and mixed-terminal physical groups are rejected.

preserved_history.scope: Initial reproduced current-flow defect: matching and wrong-ng references both passed native/application verification; independent channel readback rejected only the wrong reference.

Initial GF package-check preparation failure retained. The sparse package is extended by the existing ordinary layer adapter; subsequent source preserves original identities and permits added drawing layers.
Initial floating internal-gate fixture failed native LVS itself. It was replaced by an actually connected internal-node fixture; the old failure remains.
Primary native checks passed; the parent source-suite snapshot omitted one authentic ignored fixture log. V2 adds that file, has identical executable bytes, and repeats the exact native selection.

limits: Literal flat standard-MOS interpretation only; unsupported expressions, hierarchy, RF or ambiguous native correspondence retain visible NOT_CHECKED rather than a grouping pass.
Native LVS remains a separate result; public technology and comparison decks are unmodified.
No full geometry/operating/statistical/reliability envelope, calibrated extraction, model accuracy, installed release, foundry signoff or full device-family qualification.
Configured tool launcher hashes and native version logs are retained; this is not a new complete installed-runtime acceptance.
Four required unavailable bindings and the GF180 threshold-definition/fast-corner specification gaps remain open.
redistribution: No third-party source is newly imported into the repository by this change. Referenced PDK inputs retain their existing licenses/notices; this record retains generated facts and source/evidence identities.
